content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 #JOINT_VENTURE | Alkem Laboratories Limited (NSE: ALKEM) Alkem Laboratories incorporates Saudi Arabia JV subsidiary 'Alkem Pharma' ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Entity Name: Alkem Pharma Company - Jurisdiction: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia - Total Capital: 7,500,000 SAR - Investment: 3,825,000 SAR for 38,250 shares - Holding: 51% - Industry: Pharmaceuticals and Nutraceuticals 📌 What happened: ↳ Alkem Laboratories announced the incorporation of its subsidiary in the form of a Joint Venture named 'Alkem Pharma Company' in Saudi Arabia, holding a 51% stake with a cash consideration of 3.825 million SAR. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
